title: COASTLINE: A Context-Aware Recommender for GPU and Datacenter Configurations for LLM Fine-Tuning
description: Coastline is a context-aware recommender for GPU and datacenter configurations for LLM fine-tuning: given a workload it grid-searches configurations, filters infeasible ones, predicts throughput and power, and ranks the survivors on a performance-energy score. Throughput comes from Kavier (analytical physics) or a data-driven model; energy from Kavier-power; feasibility from IBM AutoConf.
